# Steam

> The ultimate online game platform and digital storefront for PC gaming, featuring millions of games, community features, and hardware products.

Steam is Valve Corporation's comprehensive gaming ecosystem that includes a digital game store, community features, virtual currency systems, and gaming hardware like the Steam Deck. The platform serves as the primary marketplace for PC games with integrated social features, user reviews, and content discovery tools.

## Key Topics

- Steam Store
- Steam Deck
- Steam Community
- Steam Points Shop
- Steam Market
- Game Discovery
- Virtual Reality
- Steam Mobile App
- Steam Workshop
- Controller Support
- Curators
- Authentication
- Digital Gift Cards
- Steam Charts
- Community Hub

## Core Platform & Discovery

- [Welcome to Steam](https://store.steampowered.com): Steam platform homepage with overview of games, community, and services
- [New On Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/explore/new): Browse newly released games on Steam store
- [Upcoming Releases](https://store.steampowered.com/explore/upcoming): Upcoming game releases and release calendar on Steam
- [Discounts & Events](https://store.steampowered.com/specials): Sales, discounts, and promotional events on Steam store
- [Steam Curators](https://store.steampowered.com/curators): Community curators providing game recommendations and reviews

## Account & Authentication

- [Sign In](https://store.steampowered.com/explore): Steam login and authentication page for account access
- [Friend Activity](https://store.steampowered.com/recommended/friendactivity): Friend activity recommendations requiring Steam login
- [Steam, The Ultimate Online Game Platform](https://store.steampowered.com/about): About page describing Steam ecosystem, features, and community

## Shopping & Transactions

- [Steam Points Shop](https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop): Virtual currency shop for cosmetics and in-game items on Steam
- [Steam Gift Cards](https://store.steampowered.com/digitalgiftcards): Digital gift cards for purchasing games and items on Steam
- [Steam Refunds](https://store.steampowered.com/steam_refunds): Refund policy and purchase protection information for Steam

## Hardware & Mobile

- [Steam Deck™](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1675200/Steam_Deck): Steam Deck portable gaming console product page by Valve
- [Steam Mobile App](https://store.steampowered.com/mobile): Steam Mobile App overview and features for portable access

## Content Categories

- [Virtual Reality Titles](https://store.steampowered.com/vr): Virtual reality games and titles available on Steam
- [Controller-Friendly](https://store.steampowered.com/controller): Games with controller and gamepad support on Steam

## Community & Analytics

- [Featured News - Steam News Hub](https://store.steampowered.com/news): News hub aggregating game and community updates from Steam platform
- [Steam Charts](https://store.steampowered.com/stats): Game statistics and player charts showing concurrent players and rankings

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy Agreement](https://store.steampowered.com/privacy_agreement): Privacy policy and data protection terms for Steam platform
- [Steam Subscriber Agreement](https://store.steampowered.com/subscriber_agreement): Terms of service and subscriber agreement for Steam users
- [Cookies](https://store.steampowered.com/account/cookiepreferences): Cookie preferences and privacy controls for user accounts
